title: Framer: the logo's brand menu

source.foundOn: https://screen.studio (the showcase wall on the home page)

how: ffmpeg streamed the video from its URL into cutscene's measure (256 px luma, every frame); nothing saved but these numbers and stills in scratch
whyTopTier: A deep, fast push (×2.25 in 0.41 s) from the hero headline into a small context menu, held while each item is hovered, then back out: a hidden detail made the subject.
instrument: Heavy motion blur: blurred frames read as cut candidates and split the moves, so durations here are approximate.

byEye.zoom: working ×2.25 (a 3-item menu fills a third of the frame)

classify: Screen Studio clip: a deep fast push into a small menu. Conventions: full-bleed page, enlarged pointer, hover states.

diagnose.observation: ×2.25 in 0.41 s into a three-item menu.
diagnose.principle: Zoom depth scales with the target: a small target gets a deep push.

diagnose.observation: Held while each item is hovered.
diagnose.principle: The hover states are the content, so the frame waits for them.

teaches.text: Zoom depth scales with the target: ×2.25 for a small menu.
Motion blur on fast camera moves.

critique.like: A hidden menu becomes the subject because the push is sized to it.
critique.wish: The 0.41 s push is fast enough to need motion blur to read as smooth.
critique.wonder: Could cutscene set zoom depth from the target box's area?
